productNames: Sold via Trade Me stores winbox, chargerrus and chargerruswgtn from 11th April 2022 to 13th May 2026. Smoke Alarm - LZ-1902 Model: LZ-1902, SKU: RC-10174
Smoke Alarm LZ-1902 sold via Trade Me stores
SKU: RC-10174
records.hazard: Relacom Technologies Ltd are recalling the Smoke Alarm LZ-1902 because the online product listing incorrectly stated that the product provided carbon monoxide (CO) detection capability. The product is a smoke alarm only and does not provide carbon monoxide detection. If consumers rely on the product for carbon monoxide detection when it does not provide that function, they will not be alerted to the presence of carbon monoxide. Carbon monoxide exposure can lead to serious consequences including death.
records.remedy: Stop using the product or relying on it for carbon monoxide detection. The product may continue to function as a smoke alarm; however, it does not provide carbon monoxide detection. Customers who purchased the product believing it also provided carbon monoxide detection should contact their seller to arrange a full refund.

records.title: Apeks XL4, XL4+ and Ocea Regulator Second Stages - sold at Dive Tutukaka, Dive Wellington and The Dive Doctor
brandNames: Head Oceania Pty Ltd (trading as Apeks)
productNames: Apeks XL4, XL4+ and Ocea Regulator Second Stages. Products included in this recall have serial numbers ranging from: 250402212 to 260402893 Further product identification information Sold at From To Dive Wellington 11 August 2025 8 May 2026 The Diver Doctor 27 January 2026 18 May 2026 Dive Tutukaka 30 October 2025 30 October 2025
Apeks XL4, XL4+ and Ocea Regulator Second Stages - sold at Dive Tutukaka, Dive Wellington and The Dive Doctor
serial numbers
serial number range
records.hazard: Head Oceania (trading as Apeks) is recalling these products because a manufacturing defect in the second-stage spindle assembly can restrict the flow of breathing gas at depths exceeding 45 metres. The regulator may not deliver sufficient breathing gas when required, posing a risk of inadequate air supply to the diver at depth. In an extreme situation this presents a risk of death or serious injury from asphyxiation if the regulator does not supply adequate air to a diver when used.
records.remedy: Stop using the regulator immediately if it falls within the affected serial number range. Please return the regulator to either: The authorised Apeks dealer from whom it was purchased; or Aquatech NZ, 4 Wouldbank Way, Welcome Bay, New Zealand 3112. Include clearly your name, phone number, return shipping address and store/point of purchase details. Affected regulators will be inspected and, if necessary, repaired free of charge by qualified technicians using approved Apeks replacement components. There is no charge for the inspection, repair or shipping.

productNames: Liewood Samuel Lamp & Callie Night Light Containing KRL 902030, 500 mAh, 3.7 V, 1.85 Wh lithium ion battery pack Samuel Lamp (LW14310) Callie Night Light (LW14319) Manufactured in 2021-2022 under PO numbers LW1746 and LW2168. Sold at Little Whimsy from 1 January 2021 to 23 November 2024.
Liewood Samuel Lamp & Callie Night Light - sold at Little Whimsy
records.hazard: Little Whimsy is recalling these products because they contain a lithium ion battery pack that may cause a fire. Liewood has identified that a specific batch of these batteries may change characteristics over time due to a potential production error. If the battery is overcharged or charged with incorrect voltage, it may overheat and pose a potential fire hazard. There have been rare, isolated incidents where the battery short-circuited and produced smoke, even though the product initially passed all required EU safety tests.
records.remedy: Stop using the product and discard it in accordance with your local waste disposal regulations. Contact Little Whimsy to arrange a full refund.

records.hazard: Pacific Island Investments is recalling these products because asbestos has been detected in some samples after laboratory testing. The latest Health New Zealand advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Pacific Island Investments advise you should: stop using the products immediately. email ssharma@pacificisland.co.nz with proof of purchase such as a receipt or photo of the product for a refund. follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand | WorkSafe If anyone has used these products, there is no need for urgent medical attention. You can call Healthline free anytime on 0800 611 116 to discuss any health concerns you may have. Healthline can advise if you, a child or a family member needs to see a healthcare professional for review.

records.title: Miele WWG880 WCS washing machine
productNames: Miele WWG880 WCS washing machine Material Number 12704870 Sold at Miele Experience Centre and Miele Agents across the country from 26 September 2025 to 11 February 2026.
Miele WWG880 WCS washing machine
records.hazard: The appliance’s spin cycle may operate with an incorrect speed acceleration, which may affect the machine’s overall performance. This can cause the machine to move during operation. If the appliance is installed on a platform with a height over 15cm and the appliance is not secured with a mounting bracket in accordance with the Instruction Manual, it can move during operation and tilt off the platform. This can result in the appliance’s heating system not being covered by water, which creates a risk of overheating. The risk does not arise if the appliance is used on the ground, or on a platform lower than 15cm, or if the appliance is secured in accordance with the Instruction Manual.
records.remedy: Owners of affected appliances will receive a software update and a mounting bracket to ensure that appliances that are used on a platform with a height over 15cm are securely installed in accordance with the Instruction Manual. Owners of affected appliances will be contacted by Miele to schedule a time for technician to visit, to ensure the software update is correctly installed and to ensure any appliances used on a platform with a height over 15cm are correctly installed. Note: Sufficient quantities of the brackets are currently available for the number of appliances estimated to be used on a platform with a height above 15cm. Further parts will be available and all consumers will receive a bracket whether or not the appliance is currently used on a platform. For further information, please contact Miele on 0800 4 MIELE.

records.hazard: Thermos are recalling the Thermos Stainless King Food Jars because in certain circumstances, pressure may build up inside the container If pressure builds up inside the container it can cause the stopper beneath the lid to eject forcefully without warning when opened. This may occur if contents are left in the container for an extended period, contrary to the product’s intended use.
records.remedy: Check if the underside of the stopper has a pressure relief feature (see picture provided). If not, you have an affected product and Thermos will provide a replacement stopper when contacted by you at no cost. Replacement stoppers are expected to be available within 4 to 6 weeks. When contacting Thermos, please provide your name, contact details, postal address, and a photograph of the underside of the stopper to verify the product is an affected product. You should not use the product until the replacement stopper has been installed.

records.hazard: Planet Fun are recalling this product because independent laboratory testing has detected naturally occurring Chrysotile and Tremolite asbestos in some samples of Funkee Animals and Secret Menu Stretchee Foodz. The asbestos has only been detected in the interior of the product and exposure would only occur if the product is torn. The latest Health New Zealand advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Planet Fun advises you to: Stop using the products immediately. Place the product in two ziplock bags (double bagged) and keep out of reach of children. Do not dispose of the product in the general waste. Return it to the store you purchased it from for a refund. This may require proof of purchase. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand - WorkSafe For more information contact Planet Fun: info@planetfun.co.nz

The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
detail.action: Planet Fun advises you to: Stop using the products immediately. Place the product in two ziplock bags (double bagged) and keep out of reach of children. Do not dispose of the product in the general waste. Return it to the store you purchased it from for a refund. This may require proof of purchase. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand - WorkSafe For more information contact Planet Fun: info@planetfun.co.nz

records.remedy: Consumers should return the mug to the place of purchase for a refund. Alternatively, consumers can contact Robert Gordon Australia by email at sales@robertgordonaustralia.com

productNames: Rangoli decorative powder (Ascension sand) Sold online at www.silkrute.co.nz from 1 January 2025 - 31 March 2026.
Rangoli decorative powder (Ascension sand) - sold online at Silkrute
records.hazard: Silkrute is recalling this product because testing found unidentified mineral fibres that were consistent with asbestos. The latest Health New Zealand advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand | WorkSafe If you purchased this product for personal, domestic or household use, contact the supplier for refund options. If you’ve incurred losses (e.g. in clean-up costs etc), you might be able to obtain damages from the supplier under the Consumer Guarantees Act. This will be for consumers to discuss directly with the suppliers. You can find more information on your rights with unsafe products under the CGA here Know your rights to a refund, replacement or repair | Consumer Protection If anyone has used these products, there is no need for urgent medical attention. You can call Healthline free anytime on 0800 611 116 anytime to discuss any health concerns you may have. Healthline can advise if you, a child or a family member needs to see a healthcare professional for review.

records.title: Uniti Sand Art Unicorn, Monkey, Octopus and Dinosaur - Sold at The Warehouse
productNames: Uniti Sand Art Unicorn, Monkey, Octopus and Dinosaur - Sold at The Warehouse and The Warehouse Stationery Barcodes: Monkey 9-401097-407269; Octopus 9-401097-407276; Dinosaur 9-401113-420944; Unicorn 9-401113-491869, found on the back of the product. Sold at From To The Warehouse January 2025 March 2026 Warehouse Stationery January 2025 March 2026
Uniti Sand Art Unicorn, Monkey, Octopus and Dinosaur - Sold at The Warehouse
records.hazard: The Warehouse is recalling this product as, although their own independent expert testing in November 2025 to the AS 5370:2024 standard produced a ‘no asbestos detected’ result, a NZ laboratory engaged by MBIE Product Safety to undertake a subsequent test to the previous AS 4964:2004 standard has indicated that they believe there may be traces of chrysotile and tremolite asbestos in some samples. The Warehouse advise that respirable asbestos has not been detected in any of the tested samples and the release of respirable asbestos fibres is unlikely to occur in its current state, unless the sand is processed by mechanical means such as crushing or pulverising. The Warehouse also advises that the risk that any asbestos which may be found in the product is likely to be airborne or fine enough for inhalation, is low.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. Place the product in a heavy-duty plastic bag, tape it securely and keep it out of reach of children. Do not dispose of the products in general waste. The Warehouse request you return it to the store you purchased it from for a refund. Please follow the instructions provided by the store staff when returning products to store. Please ensure you follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Other workplaces from WorkSafe here .

productNames: Sold at Kmart from 25 June 2025 to 6 March 2026. 2L Stainless Steel Top Handle Drink Bottle. SKU: 43544523 (Khaki), 43544530 (Black)
2L Stainless Steel Top Handle Drink Bottle - Sold at Kmart
records.hazard: Kmart is recalling this drink bottle because the lid threading may shrink when exposed to hot liquids, causing the lid to eject as a projectile. records.remedy: Do not use the drink bottle for hot liquids. Return the drink bottle to Kmart for a full refund. Contact Kmart if you are unable to return the drink bottle or have sold or gifted it to another person.

records.title: FACOM Toukan electrician’s knives
productNames: Sold at Sutton Tools NZ from January to December 2025 FACOM Toukan electrician’s knives 640180PB The Affected Products are twin-blade knives intended for use by electricians, with a shorter 35mm blade for cable work and a longer, 65mm general-purpose blade. The knives were manufactured between January 2024 and April 2025. Only one unit of the Affected Products was sold to a distributor in New Zealand.
FACOM Toukan electrician’s knives
records.hazard: The Affected Products are twin-blade knives intended for use by electricians, with a shorter 35mm blade for cable work and a longer, 65mm general-purpose blade. FACOM has determined that there is the possibility that the blades may not be locked in place when fully extended for use. The blade may therefore fold into the housing without depressing the lock release button if pressure is exerted on the back of the knife blade. If the knife folds unexpectedly, this could pose a laceration hazard to end users. The probability of injury to end users has been assessed as high risk.
records.remedy: End users are being advised to immediately stop using Affected Products and to contact Stanley Black & Decker NZ to arrange the return and replacement of Affected Products.

productNames: This recall applies to all Specialized "Como SL" electric bicycle models: Como SL 4.0 and Como SL 5.0. “Como SL” is printed on the bicycle’s seat tube or top tube. The bikes were sold in a variety of colors: Como SL 4.0: Cast Umber, Dove Grey and Raspberry Como SL 5.0: Smoke, Brassy Yellow and Brushed Silver Note that there is also a range of bikes called "Como" which is a different design and not part of this recall.

serial number
records.hazard: Specialized New Zealand has recalled this bicycle because the fork steerer tube may develop a small fatigue crack. This could lead to a progressive failure of the fork, posing a fall hazard.
records.remedy: Stop riding the bicycle immediately. Contact your nearest authorized Specialized retailer with your bike serial number to be logged and schedule an appointment for free replacement of the fork (estimated to be available May 2026).

Rangoli Colour - sold at DH Supermarkets
records.hazard: Farm Fresh is recalling this product because testing found unidentified mineral fibres that were consistent with asbestos. The latest health advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand | WorkSafe If you purchased this product for personal, domestic or household use, contact the supplier for refund options. If you’ve incurred losses (e.g. in clean-up costs etc), you might be able to obtain damages from the supplier under the Consumer Guarantees Act. This will be for consumers to discuss directly with the suppliers. You can find more information on your rights with unsafe products under the CGA here Know your rights to a refund, replacement or repair | Consumer Protection If anyone has used these products, there is no need for urgent medical attention. You can call Healthline free anytime on 0800 611 116 anytime to discuss any health concerns you may have. Healthline can advise if you, a child or a family member needs to see a healthcare professional for review.

records.title: Potentially Asbestos Impacted Pyropanel-brand fire-rated doors manufactured by Firemex
productNames: Sold at AceDoor Systems from 30 August 2023 to 26 August 2025 Pyropanel-brand fire-rated doors manufactured by Firemex Pty Ltd Certain Pyropanel FRB core within fire-rated doors supplied by Assa Abloy, manufactured by Firemex Pty Ltd and sold by AceDoor Systems 2013 Limited between 2023 and 2025 may have also been impacted by a contamination issue. Doors can be identified by the Fire Door Tag (label) on the hinge edge of the door which will identify whether door is from the 2023 to 2025 period. Contact Firemex with an image of your label, if you are unsure.
Potentially Asbestos Impacted Pyropanel-brand fire-rated doors manufactured by Firemex
records.hazard: Firemex have advised that the fire-rated door core used in some fire doors may be contaminated with asbestos fibres. In January 2026 WorkSafe confirmed that if the fire doors remain intact, they pose negligible to no risk of asbestos exposure. WorkSafe also clarified that if the door is installed in a way that exposes the fire door core, or if the damage to the door occurs that exposes the fire door core then there may be a risk of Asbestos exposure.
records.remedy: Do not cut, drill, sand, or carry out any invasive work on any doors that may be affected. If the door is fully installed and intact: it can remain in place, as intact doors pose negligible to no risk. If the door is uninstalled, partly installed, or damaged so that the core is exposed: stop work immediately and contact Firemex for instructions. Building owners should follow their Asbestos Management Plan and treat affected doors as potentially containing asbestos until testing confirms otherwise. Firemex will advise whether testing, replacement, or disposal is required and will guide customers through the process and next steps. In January 2026 WorkSafe confirmed that if the fire doors remain intact, they pose negligible to no risk of asbestos exposure. WorkSafe also clarified that if the door is installed in a way that exposes the fire door core, or if the damage to the door occurs that exposes the fire door core then immediate remediation must be undertaken with an organisation’s Asbestos Management Plan (AMP).

detail.title: Potentially Asbestos Impacted Pyropanel-brand fire-rated doors manufactured by Firemex
detail.metaDescription: Firemex have advised that the fire-rated door core used in some fire doors may be contaminated with asbestos fibres. In January 2026 WorkSafe confirmed that if the fire doors remain intact, they pose negligible to no risk of asbestos exposure. WorkSafe also clarified that if the door is installed in a way that exposes the fire door core, or if the damage to the door occurs that exposes the fire door core then there may be a risk of Asbestos exposure. Do not cut, drill, sand, or carry out any invasive work on any doors that may be affected. If the door is fully installed and intact: it can remain in place, as intact doors pose negligible to no risk. If the door is uninstalled, partly installed, or damaged so that the core is exposed: stop work immediately and contact Firemex for instructions. Building owners should follow their Asbestos Management Plan and treat affected doors as potentially containing asbestos until testing confirms otherwise. Firemex will advise whether testing, replacement, or disposal is required and will guide customers through the process and next steps. In January 2026 WorkSafe confirmed that if the fire doors remain intact, they pose negligible to no risk of asbestos exposure. records.hazard: A potential asbestos contamination concern has been raised about this decorative non-edible product following a customer report. While the product is sold strictly as decorative fake sugar and not intended for consumption, it may present a health risk if handled or ingested. The recall is being conducted as a precaution while the safety of the material is being reviewed with the supplier.
records.remedy: Customers should stop using the product immediately and keep it out of reach of children. Please contact Tiny Sugar for a full refund and instructions for safe disposal or return. records.hazard: Daikoku are recalling all Anessa sunscreens because the products were labelled in Japanese, without any English translation, which does not meet the mandatory labelling requirements for the New Zealand market. Many of the sunscreen products were not labelled with the permitted Sun Protection Factor (SPF). As a result of these labelling defects, consumers may not be able to properly identify the product's SPF or understand the usage instructions, leading to an increased risk of sunburn or inadequate sun protection. This poses a significant health risk, particularly for individuals with sensitive skin or those who rely on the product's stated SPF and water resistance.
records.remedy: Consumers should stop using the affected sunscreen products immediately and return the products to the place of purchase for a refund.

records.hazard: Tremolite asbestos has been detected in some samples after laboratory testing. The latest health advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. For safe disposal, follow advice from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand. records.hazard: Daikoku are recalling all Pigeon sunscreens because the products were labelled in Japanese, without any English translation, which does not meet the mandatory labelling requirements for the New Zealand market. Many of the sunscreen products were not labelled with the permitted Sun Protection Factor (SPF). As a result of these labelling defects, consumers may not be able to properly identify the product's SPF or understand the usage instructions, leading to an increased risk of sunburn or inadequate sun protection. This poses a significant health risk, particularly for individuals with sensitive skin or those who rely on the product's stated SPF and water resistance.
records.remedy: Consumers should stop using the affected sunscreen products immediately and return the products to the place of purchase for a refund.

records.title: STIHL MotoMix Pre-Mixed Fuel (5L)
productNames: STIHL MotoMix Pre-Mixed Fuel sold from 7 August 2025 to 18 December 2025. Please see attached a list of Dealers who stocked cans with the affected NCI dates. Not all units with these NCIs will exhibit the defect. Consumers who purchased cans with the identified NCI date from these Dealers during this period should check for leakage. MotoMix Dealer List
STIHL MotoMix Pre-Mixed Fuel (5L)
records.hazard: STIHL has identified that a limited batch of 5L MotoMix cans have been potentially leaking due to a manufacturing defect affecting the can (the MotoMix product itself is not affected). It is typically detected by the oily residue on the can or on surfaces on which the can was sitting, or a solvent aroma. There is a risk of injury including skin or eye irritation, drowsiness or dizziness or risk of harm if the fuel is handled or swallowed. The defect may also pose a fire hazard if the fuel leaks near an ignition source.
records.remedy: Check cans for dates sold and stockists in the identifiers section and if leakage is detected, or you are concerned that your tin may be leaking, please follow these steps: • Handle carefully. MotoMix is a flammable substance and should be kept away from ignition sources, sparks, open flames, and excessive heat. Avoid breathing in fumes. • Place in a safe, well-ventilated area away from ignition sources. • Contact your local STIHL Dealer or STIHL Customer Service Support to arrange disposal and a refund under the Consumer Guarantees Act. Do not travel with leaking fuel cans.

It is typically detected by the oily residue on the can or on surfaces on which the can was sitting, or a solvent aroma. There is a risk of injury including skin or eye irritation, drowsiness or dizziness or risk of harm if the fuel is handled or swallowed. The defect may also pose a fire hazard if the fuel leaks near an ignition source. Check cans for dates sold and stockists in the identifiers section and if leakage is detected, or you are concerned that your tin may be leaking, please follow these steps:• Handle carefully. MotoMix is a flammable substance and should be kept away from ignition sources, sparks, open flames, and excessive heat. Avoid breathing in fumes.• Place in a safe, well-ventilated area away from ignition sources.• Contact your local STIHL Dealer or STIHL Customer Service Support to arrange disposal and a refund under the Consumer Guarantees Act. Do not travel with leaking fuel cans.
detail.productIdentifiers: STIHL MotoMix Pre-Mixed Fuel sold from 7 August 2025 to 18 December 2025. Please see attached a list of Dealers who stocked cans with the affected NCI dates. Not all units with these NCIs will exhibit the defect. Consumers who purchased cans with the identified NCI date from these Dealers during this period should check for leakage. MotoMix Dealer List

records.title: Rangoli Powder - Pack of 6 and Pack of 10, sold at Big Bazaar
productNames: Rangoli Powder - Pack of 6 and Pack of 10, sold at Big Bazaar from 31/10/2023 to 20/01/2026.
Rangoli Powder - Pack of 6 and Pack of 10, sold at Big Bazaar
records.hazard: The product is being recalled by Big Bazaar because testing found unidentified mineral fibres that were consistent with tremolite asbestos. The latest health advice is: Exposure to asbestos does not cause any immediate health problems. The health conditions linked to asbestos develop over a long period – typically 15 to 40 years. The risk of developing asbestos-related health conditions, such as some types of cancer and lung disease, is linked to the nature and quantity of asbestos and the length of time a person was exposed to it. There is no safe level and therefore we try to avoid all exposure. For most people who have these products at home, the quantities involved will be small. That is very different to the greater risk for people who might be exposed during construction work or through the mining industry.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. Follow the specialist advice on safe containment, removal and disposal for: Households/individuals from Health NZ here Asbestos in sand Educational facilities from Ministry of Education here Asbestos in coloured sand - Ministry of Education Other workplaces from WorkSafe here Asbestos in coloured sand | WorkSafe If you purchased this product for personal, domestic or household use, contact the supplier or store for refund options. If you’ve incurred losses (e.g. in clean-up costs etc), you might be able to obtain damages from the supplier under the Consumer Guarantees Act. This will be for consumers to discuss directly with the suppliers. You can find more information on your rights with unsafe products under the CGA here Know your rights to a refund, replacement or repair | Consumer Protection To arrange a refund for this product, please provide proof of purchase (a receipt of purchase or a photo of the product with the current date written beside it) to bigbazaar302@gmail.com. If anyone has used these products, there is no need for urgent medical attention. You can call Healthline free anytime on 0800 611 116 anytime to discuss any health concerns you may have. Healthline can advise if you, a child or a family member needs to see a healthcare professional for review.

records.hazard: Tuozhu Technology Limited have recalled the Bambu Lab A1 3D printers sold at Mindkits NZ from 8 /11/2023 to 27/1/2024. The heatbed cable in affected printers can be damaged if bent during shipping or as installed. This can cause a short-circuit and spark or burn through the insulation layer, resulting in electric shock or a fire.
records.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled 3D printers, and email a1recall@bambulab.com to arrange a remedy under the Consumer Guarantees Act of either: (1) return of their A1 3D printers for a full refund, or (2) for free replacement of the heatbed and cable by a local electronics repair facility. Consumers requesting a full refund will be sent a prepaid shipping label to return the printer.

detail.metaDescription: The product is being recalled by Kmart because the gel pak may include ethylene glycol, a toxic substance (rather than the non-toxic ingredient glycerol). If packaging becomes damaged, ethylene glycol can leak out and if swallowed, can cause irreversible injuries or death. 1. Stop using the Gel Pak immediately and keep out of reach of children. 2. Return the product to a Kmart store for a full refund. For further information contact Kmart - supplier details below.
detail.productIdentifiers: Sold at Kmart NZ stores and online at kmart.co.nz Anko Small Gel Pak sold from 25/06/2018 - 24/12/2025, Keycode 42010777 Anko Large Gel Pak sold from 25/06/2018 - 21/12/2025, Keycode 42010784

records.hazard: The coaster brake on the rear wheel may malfunction during use. Risk of accident and serious injury if the coaster brake on the rear wheel malfunctions during use, preventing the rider from stopping safely and causing a fall.
records.remedy: Immediately stop using your Giant Animator and Liv Adore (Coaster Brake) bicycle. Check your bicycle serial number to see if it is affected: You can find the serial number either stamped on the underside of the bottom bracket shell, or on a sticker located at the base of the down tube on its underside. If the serial number of your bicycle matches any on the list of affected bicycles, return your bicycle to an authorised Giant and Liv dealer for a free inspection and replacement of the rear wheel. Contact Giant by email or phone if you are unable to return the product or have sold or gifted it to another person.

detail.hazard: The coaster brake on the rear wheel may malfunction during use. Risk of accident and serious injury if the coaster brake on the rear wheel malfunctions during use, preventing the rider from stopping safely and causing a fall.
detail.action: Immediately stop using your Giant Animator and Liv Adore (Coaster Brake) bicycle. Check your bicycle serial number to see if it is affected: You can find the serial number either stamped on the underside of the bottom bracket shell, or on a sticker located at the base of the down tube on its underside. If the serial number of your bicycle matches any on the list of affected bicycles, return your bicycle to an authorised Giant and Liv dealer for a free inspection and replacement of the rear wheel. Contact Giant by email or phone if you are unable to return the product or have sold or gifted it to another person.

records.hazard: The product is being recalled by Ace Amusements because samples have tested positive for tremolite asbestos. The product may cause a risk to health as asbestos has been detected in some samples after laboratory testing. Importantly, respirable asbestos has not been detected in any of the tested samples. The release of respirable asbestos fibres is unlikely to occur in its current state, unless the sand is processed by mechanical means such as crushing or pulverising. The risk that any asbestos found, that is likely to be airborne or fine enough for inhalation, is low.
records.remedy: Stop using the products immediately. Please return to the store where the product was purchased for a ticket refund. records.title: Galt branded Mini Makes Sand Stickers
productNames: Sold at Toyworld Albany and Toyworld Johnsonville from 1 August 2023 to 30 August 2023 Sold at Mighty Ape from 1 August 2023 to 30 July 2024 Galt branded Mini Makes Sand Stickers 1005467 on the packaging GN5467 is the item code we have sold the products under
Galt branded Mini Makes Sand Stickers
records.hazard: Modern Brands have recalled this product because independent laboratory testing has detected naturally occurring Chrysotile asbestos in some samples of Galt - Mini Makes - Sand Stickers. Importantly, no respirable asbestos has been detected. The presence of asbestos fibre bundles does not imply that there is a risk of asbestos exposure. Asbestos fibres are hazardous only if they are sufficiently fine, airborne and inhaled in sufficient quantity. The release of respirable asbestos fibres is unlikely to occur unless the sand is processed by mechanical means such as crushing or pulverising. records.hazard: White craft sand ('Sugar') used on the earrings has been independently recalled by the supplier citing asbestos contamination, potentially leading to asbestos contamination on the earrings. While the craft sand has been baked onto the clay and then stuck on with resin, reducing the possibility of asbestos fibers becoming airborne, a hazard remains from potential asbestos contamination on the product.
records.remedy: Stop wearing them. Place them in a sealed bag or container. Place that bag into a second plastic bag and seal securely with tape. Contact your local council for details of disposal. Refer to further advice on disposal and clean up from Health NZ here Asbestos in san d. Contact Joy's Handmade Boutique to arrange a remedy under the Consumer Guarantees Act.
